verdict.rationale: The product is a laptop processor (CPU/GPU/NPU silicon). User-controlled data retention and deletion is a policy axis for services and software that store user data, which makes it a category error for a chip. Nothing in the evidence shows the processor itself offering retention or deletion controls; mentions of AI running locally describe where compute happens, not data-lifecycle control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
